name: The Westin Hapuna Beach Resort
insider_take: This oceanfront paradise sits on one of Hawaii's most pristine white sand beaches, where ancient Hawaiian royalty once retreated and world-class golf meets dramatic volcanic landscapes.
whats_special: The resort boasts direct access to Hapuna Beach, consistently ranked among the world's best beaches by Condé Nast Traveler. The property features the renowned Hapuna Golf Course, designed by Arnold Palmer and Ed Seay, which winds through ancient lava flows with stunning ocean views. The hotel's architecture incorporates traditional Hawaiian design elements while offering modern luxury amenities.
pro_tip: Book a sunset dinner at the resort's Meridia restaurant – the unobstructed western exposure offers some of the Big Island's most spectacular sunset views over the Pacific.
dont_miss: The nearby Puukohola Heiau National Historic Site, an ancient Hawaiian temple built by King Kamehameha I, and snorkeling at Spencer Beach Park just minutes away. The resort's location also provides easy access to Mauna Kea's world-famous stargazing opportunities and the historic Waimea town with its paniolo (Hawaiian cowboy) culture.
pros: Direct access to pristine Hapuna Beach, consistently rated among world's best beaches
Signature Westin Heavenly Beds and premium spa amenities for ultimate relaxation
Multiple dining venues featuring fresh local Hawaiian ingredients and oceanfront settings
Championship golf course designed by Arnold Palmer with stunning ocean views
Extensive cultural programming showcasing authentic Hawaiian traditions and activities
cons: Remote Big Island location requires longer travel time from mainland US
Premium luxury pricing reflects exclusive beachfront positioning
